tags.description: A comic entombed in a sonically-sealed acrylic case the size of a dinner tray, with a printed label across the top: SISTER STEEL #1 · NEAR MINT · 9.4 · WHITE PAGES. It weighs more than it has any business weighing. You cannot read it. That is not what it is for, and the man who sold it to you will explain that at length if you give him any opening at all.
